heroBody: Log in with Spotify to see the artists, tracks and albums you play the most, your listening habits by hour, and your own “Wrapped” – any time, no need to wait for December.
notConfigured: VITE_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID is not configured. Create an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, add the Redirect URI {{redirectUri}}, then put it in your .env file.
featuresTitle: Everything you ever wanted to know about your listening habits.

features.title: Top artists
features.body: A top-3 podium and a chart of up to 99 artists – over 4 weeks, 6 months or 1 year.

features.title: Top tracks
features.body: The songs you replay the most, plus loyalty, decade taste and peak listening hours.

features.title: Top albums
features.body: Spotify has no top-albums API – timuze derives it from your 99 most-played tracks.

features.title: Real stream counts
features.body: Import your Spotify data export to get stream counts, hours listened and a "Wrapped" for every year.

features.title: Heatmap
features.body: See which days and hours you listen, on which devices, and how many tracks you skip.

features.title: Private
features.body: No server. Your token and data stay in your browser only (OAuth PKCE).

steps.title: Log in with Spotify
steps.body: Grant read access to your top items, recent plays and library. Your data is only read – playback control is used only when you press play on the turntable.

steps.title: Pick a time range
steps.body: 4 weeks, 6 months or a whole year – every stat updates instantly.

steps.title: Explore & import more
steps.body: Drop in your full streaming history to unlock yearly stats.

outro: Every press of play is a diary entry. timuze helps you read that diary back – beautifully.
